b.label: 10 U.S.C. 119 - Special Access Programs: Congressional Oversight

edges.label: Security-support primes administer the compartmentation the statute is supposed to make visible
edges.note: Reasoning: Sec. 119 places the reporting duty on the Secretary of Defense, but the underlying program-protection and access records are held by contractors with no independent reporting obligation to Congress.

edges.label: The access architecture that denied Grusch his read-ons is largely contractor-built and contractor-maintained
edges.note: Grusch was tasked to inventory the SAPs and CAPs relevant to the Task Force's congressional mandate and was refused. The billet lists, access rosters and classification guides that execute such refusals are administered in substantial part by security-support primes. No committee has requested those rosters.

a.label: FY2024 NDAA sec. 1687 - Limitation on Use of Funds for Certain Unreported Programs

edges.label: The IR&D restriction applies directly to covered prime contractors
edges.note: DoDI 3204.01 covers major contractors allocating over $11 million in IR&D and bid-and-proposal costs; the primes on this board are all covered contractors, and none has publicly reported a disclosure under Sec. 1687(b).

a.label: FY2024 NDAA, Public Law 118-31 - Div. A, Title XVIII, Subtitle C (secs. 1841-1843), UAP Records Collection; Div. G (IAA FY2024) secs. 7341, 7343

edges.label: The records collection reaches government-funded contractor-held records
edges.note: Sec. 1841 defines the collection as record copies of all 'Government, Government-provided, or Government-funded records' relating to UAP, technologies of unknown origin and non-human intelligence - a formulation that reaches services primes holding classified records under contract. No accounting of contractor holdings has been made.

b.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.label: AAWSAP contract performed from Las Vegas
edges.note: AAWSAP was performed by BAASS out of Robert Bigelow's Nevada base rather than from Washington, which is what puts this programme on a map of southern Nevada at all. Two limits keep it at tier 2. The federal award system places BIGELOW AEROSPACE LLC at North Las Vegas - a separate municipality from Las Vegas - on NASA contracts, not on the DIA contract; and searches of USASpending for 'Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies' and for 'BAASS' both return nothing, so the AAWSAP contract is not in the public award record under either name.

edges.label: Reid's Nevada base; earmark performed by a Las Vegas constituent
edges.note: This is not merely a home-town link. AARO's official history names 'Senate Majority Leader Harry Reid (D-NV)' as having directed the appropriation, and the federal award record places Bigelow's company in Nevada; the money Reid secured was performed by a company in the state he represented. Tier 2 because the constituent relationship is the inference joining those two documented facts, not something either document states.

edges.label: Leidos is the government services business spun out of SAIC in 2013
edges.note: The split moved the classified services portfolio, and whatever records attach to it, into a separate corporate entity.

edges.label: the prime where classified contract line items and sworn allegation meet
edges.note: Lockheed Martin's prime contract obligations run to the hundreds of billions of dollars in USAspending records, a portion carried as classified line items visible in financial systems only as a number. It is also the only company named on the floor of a congressional hearing by a sworn witness in connection with the custody allegation, which makes it the test case for whether contracting records can be made to answer the question.

b.label: Nevada Test Site / Nevada National Security Site

edges.label: A Northrop Grumman-led consortium took over Nevada Test Site management in 2006
edges.note: National Security Technologies LLC succeeded Bechtel Nevada, inheriting the Remote Sensing Laboratory, the Special Technologies Laboratory and the classified support infrastructure adjacent to Groom Lake.

edges.label: Radiance is a mid-tier technical prime in the space where compartmented analytical tasks are placed
edges.note: Reasoning: roughly $2.6 billion in prime obligations since FY2008 across intelligence, sensors and advanced concepts. Radiance recurs in UAP-adjacent reporting as an employer of personnel who moved between government UAP work and industry, but no primary personnel record has been located and none is asserted.

edges.label: sensor-side prime - the contractor-generated data category nobody is asking for
edges.note: Raytheon builds the AN/APG-79 and ATFLIR families through which the military detects and images the objects at issue, which makes it the corporate custodian of a withheld category of contractor-generated sensor data distinct from the custody allegation. Graded Tier 2: no source places Raytheon in any UAP-specific contract vehicle, and the edge rests on documented prime-contractor role plus hearing-record discussion of sensor data.

edges.label: SAIC held the government's remote viewing research line after it left SRI
edges.note: A documented instance of a deniable government research program in an anomalous subject moving wholesale into corporate custody, terminated after an external assessment.

a.label: To The Stars Academy of Arts & Science Inc. (later To The Stars Inc.)

edges.label: Securities disclosure is why the TTSA arrangement is visible and a privately held prime's would not be
edges.note: TTSA's Reg A reporting obligations forced the CRADA into the public record. A privately held prime such as General Atomics has no equivalent obligation, which is the structural reason the documented case is a small company rather than a large one.
